interpretation: All original data, Fresh40 and earlier sensitivities have already been inspected. These additions are exploratory; no prospective confirmation is claimed.

fresh40.data: V4 saved per-case predictions; no new fitting
fresh40.intervals: 10,000 paired whole-fact group bootstrap draws; target-specific and equal-target intervals; fixed fitted predictors; 95% unadjusted descriptive intervals
fresh40.leave_one_target_out: Equal mean of the other two fixed targets, not inference to a model population
fresh40.diagnostics: Absolute errors, target-specific outcome scale, agreement frequencies, gains by relation/strength/observed agreement, and group influence. Descriptive associations are not mechanisms.

factorial.data: Saved 7,200 four-rotation report aggregates and frozen answer identities
additional_outcomes: q_document minus q_prior using all four normalized roles
factorial.bootstrap: 10,000 relation-stratified whole ordered-triple group draws using the original fixed-fold estimability rule and seed 20261016
factorial.role_profiles: Means of all four normalized role supports by target and answer visibility
factorial.association: Difference in mean q_document-minus-q_prior between recorded answers C and P, separately shown/hidden, and their shown-minus-hidden difference; I answers retained in role summaries but excluded from this explicitly C-versus-P association
factorial.limitations: Answer role is observed, not randomized. Association is not an accuracy or faithfulness measure. New intervals are descriptive 95%, unadjusted; original four primary adjusted intervals remain unchanged.

verification: Reconstruct every existing pooled post hoc point and CI
Reconstruct original factorial primary category contrasts and per-target intervals
Require immutable experimental and original analysis inputs unchanged
